supersedes_only: the window-span clause of control/resource-stability-addendum-v1.json (span >= 290 s) for per-child ADMISSION checks evaluated at arbitrary instants
new_clause: window [now-300, now] must contain >= 25 complete samples spanning >= 280 s (two sample periods below 300 s); all other clauses unchanged: last sample age 0..30 s, strictly increasing tz-aware timestamps, last free >= 13.5e9 + projected, peak-to-later drop <= max(3e8, (last_free-13.5e9)//12), fresh statvfs >= 12.2e9 + projected.

evidence.reason: C4 admission refused at 01:39:15 with 'window span 280.0s < 290 s' while the stream was otherwise healthy (gate checks before and after passed; observer gaps 10-11 s with 1 s timestamp resolution; a just-appended or slightly late sample can leave the newest complete line ~10 s older).

rationale: The 290 s clause is satisfiable only when sampling phase and write timing align; it refuses spuriously at a 10 s cadence. 280 s still requires ~5 minutes of continuous stable history. Stricter existing gates (stability_gate_v2 at 290 s) remain valid and may keep their stricter value.
scope: Applies to new runner versions that adopt it explicitly; no running process changes behaviour.
